data.title: JPMorgan Strategists Raise S&P 500 Target as AI Capex Pays Off
data.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists raised their S&P 500 Index forecast for a second time in two months, citing strong corporate earnings and the payoff from massive artificial intelligence spending.
